item.title: APD searching for woman last seen almost two weeks ago
item.description: Austin Police are asking for the public's help finding a woman last seen almost two weeks ago.

item.title: Man allegedly started fire at H-E-B Riverside to steal alcohol: Austin Fire
item.description: After a fire Tuesday at a local H-E-B store, Austin Fire (AFD) arrested a man whom one of its detectives alleges intentionally started the fire as cover for the theft of alcohol, according to an arrest affidavit obtained Thursday by KXAN.

item.title: Former Westlake star Drew Brees inducted into NFL Hall of Fame
item.description: Drew Brees joined four other football legends in the 2026 NFL Hall of Fame class, announced Thursday during the NFL Honors awards show. The former Chaparral threw for more than 80,000 yards and 571 touchdowns in his 20-year NFL career, and even after he heard his name called and he walked onto the stage, he still couldn't believe where he was.

item.title: School walkouts continue despite state funding warning
item.description: On Friday, more students from across Central Texas continued protests against Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). KXAN received multiple videos showing students protesting.

item.title: Juvenile detention center supervision officer arrested on child sexual assault charges, LCSO says
item.description: A juvenile supervision officer at a juvenile detention center has been arrested and charged with sexual assault of a child, according to the Llano County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: AFD captain fired over alleged timekeeping fraud, policy violations
item.description: A captain at the Austin Fire Department was fired late last month after the city of Austin says she allegedly violated several city policies and was found to be engaging in timekeeping fraud.

item.title: Judge sides with city of Austin in convention center petition lawsuit
item.description: The ruling clears the way for the city to continue that massive project, already well underway.

item.title: 'Purge them from our classrooms': Behind the push to oust Texas teachers who commented on Charlie Kirk
item.description: KXAN reviewed every record we could find of educators facing allegations of "inappropriate" comments about Kirk. Records we obtained show for weeks following his assassination, Texas educators were reported, reprimanded, fired, threatened and doxed online over posts some believed celebrated his death.

item.title: Austin ISD updates protest protocols for staff, campus police as walkouts continue
item.description: The Austin Independent School District is updating its protocols for how campus police officers will monitor student walkout protests.
